title: Restricted Lie operations and the tensor enveloping quotient
statement: Let $F$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $L$ be a Lie algebra over $F$ [def-wf-lie-algebra], let $p\in\mathbf N$ and $q:L\to L$. Define $C_{m,k}(x,y)$ recursively by $C_{0,0}=x$, $C_{0,k}=0$ for $k>0$, $C_{m+1,0}=[y,C_{m,0}]$, and $C_{m+1,k+1}=[x,C_{m,k}]+[y,C_{m,k+1}]$. These are the formal coefficients of $\operatorname{ad}(tx+y)^m(x)$ in $L\otimes_F F[t]$. Put $s_i(x,y)=(i\cdot1_F)^{-1}C_{p-1,i-1}(x,y)$ for $1\le i<p$. In prime characteristic $p$, a restricted operation is a map $q$ satisfying $q(cx)=c^p q(x)$, $\operatorname{ad}(q(x))=\operatorname{ad}(x)^p$, and $q(x+y)=q(x)+q(y)+\sum_{i=1}^{p-1}s_i(x,y)$ for all $c\in F$, $x,y\in L$. For any $p,q$ as above, let $T_F(L)$ be the tensor algebra with degree-one inclusion $\iota$; put $r(x,y)=\iota(x)\iota(y)-\iota(y)\iota(x)-\iota([x,y])$ and $v(x)=\iota(x)^p-\iota(q(x))$. Let $J$ be the two-sided ideal generated by all $r(x,y)$ and $v(x)$. Define the restricted enveloping tensor quotient to be $T_F(L)/J$, with its inherited $F$-algebra structure and linear map $L\to T_F(L)/J$ induced by $\iota$.
